# The headless client (C2.9): what an attached client's terminal shows, for a few layouts.
# Panes run fixed commands that print and wait, never an interactive shell.
# The status line is off (screen.conf) until imux-core draws it (C4.2); both engines run
# these since C3.6.
conf screen.conf
size 40x10
run new-session -d -s a 'printf "one pane\n\033[1;31mbold red\033[0m \033[44mon blue\033[0m\n"; exec cat'
wait -t %0 '#{cursor_y}' == 2
screen 40x10
run split-window -h -t %0 'printf "right\n"; exec cat'
wait -t %1 '#{cursor_y}' == 1
screen 40x10
run split-window -v -t %1 'printf "bottom right\n"; exec cat'
wait -t %2 '#{cursor_y}' == 1
run select-pane -t %0
screen 40x10
run resize-pane -Z -t %0
screen 40x10
# Border styles from the options (C4.1), one of them a format.
run resize-pane -Z -t %0 ; set -g pane-border-style 'fg=red,dim' ; set -g pane-active-border-style 'fg=#{?pane_active,#00ff00,blue} bold'
screen 40x10
run set -g pane-border-indicators off ; set -g pane-border-style 'bg=colour238 fg=default'
screen 40x10
run kill-server
